I’m Leann Budlong, a Data Science student interested in
using data and computational methods to understand and solve
real-world problems.

My studies have given me experience working with data
analysis, machine learning, statistical methods, Python,
and Jupyter-based workflows.

Deep Learning interests me because of its ability to learn
complex patterns from data and its applications in areas
such as computer vision, natural language processing, and
intelligent systems.

Throughout this course, I aim to strengthen both my
theoretical understanding and practical ability to develop
Deep Learning solutions.

Welcome to my Deep Learning Portfolio.

This portfolio presents my learning journey throughout the
Deep Learning course, documenting the concepts I studied,
laboratory activities I completed, assignments I developed,
and projects I worked on.

Rather than simply presenting final answers, this portfolio
shows the process behind my work — from experimentation and
implementation to results, analysis, and reflection.

This portfolio is organized into four main areas:

🧪 Laboratory Activities

Practical exercises and experiments completed throughout
the course.

📝 Assignments

Course assignments demonstrating my understanding and
application of Deep Learning concepts.

🚀 Projects

Larger projects that combine concepts, implementation,
experimentation, and analysis.

💭 Reflections

Reflections on my learning, challenges, discoveries,
and development throughout the course.
---

## My Learning Journey

Throughout this course, I explored how Deep Learning can
be used to solve problems involving data, images, and
other complex patterns.

My work focuses not only on building models, but also on
understanding:

- How neural networks learn
- How data is prepared for deep learning
- How models are trained and optimized
- How model performance is evaluated
- How different architectures affect results
- How experiments can be interpreted and improved

---

## Tools & Technologies

Some of the tools and technologies used throughout my
learning journey include:

`Python` · `Jupyter Notebook` · `NumPy` · `Pandas` ·
`Matplotlib` · `Scikit-learn` · `PyTorch` · `TensorFlow`

---
